body:
Vampire Deer CR 1/4

This deer lifts its head at your approach, revealing its majestic antlers and its extended canines.

XP 100
N Medium animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 13, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 natural)
hp 11 (2d8+2)
Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee bite +2 (1d4+1) or gore +2 (1d6+1), 2 hooves – 3 (1d4)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 15, Con 12, Int 2, Wis 14, Cha 6
Base Attack +1; CMB +2; CMD 15 (19 vs. trip)
Feats Dodge (B), Mobility (B), Run
Skills Acrobatics +2 (+6 jump), Perception +10, Stealth +10 (+14 in forests), Swim +5; Racial Modifiers 4 Perception, +4 Stealth (+8 in forests), +4 Swim

ECOLOGY

Environment grasslands, mountains, river lands, and swamps
Organization solitary, mated pair, herd (2–20)
Treasure none

Also known as a water deer, the vampire deer is differentiated from its more mundane cousins by having elongated canines they use to defend themselves and in disputes with rival deer. While they share this aspect with the muntjac deer, the vampire deer is larger than the smaller muntjac.
